recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, low-key photographic portrait of a woman with a large, rounded afro that fills the majority of the frame, featuring a top-centered stylized title and a circular yellow hype sticker in the upper-right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark, voluminous hair acts as a textured frame for the face.
The bright yellow sticker provides a high-contrast focal point against the dark background.
The centered title anchors the vertical axis of the composition.
coreInvariants: Low-key lighting with deep shadows in the hair and background.
Warm, saturated skin tones with soft highlights on the lips and nose.
A circular graphic element placed asymmetrically to balance the centered subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait, centered, with the afro occupying approximately 70% of the canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright yellow circular sticker.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the centered title, moves down to the eyes, then jumps to the high-contrast sticker in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the dark texture of the hair serves as the primary negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (hair and background).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow (sticker) and vibrant red (title outline/lips).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the yellow sticker and the dark background; low value contrast within the facial shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, black, and primary yellow/red accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight display serif and condensed sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Title uses a thick, rounded serif with interlocking or overlapping characters.
Sticker text uses a highly condensed, bold sans-serif for maximum information density.
High-contrast outlines on the main title to separate it from the dark background.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' and 'S' in the title feature exaggerated, bulbous curves.
Tight kerning in the sticker text to fit multiple lines within the circle.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the top edge of the hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A whimsical, heavy display face for the artist name paired with a utilitarian, condensed sans-serif for technical/promotional details.
graphicDevices: Circular hype sticker with a thin black border.

preserve: The circular shape of the sticker
The top-centered position of the main title
The red/white color scheme of the title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, 70s aesthetic of the display text.
Matches the dense, bold uppercase look of the sticker text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, 1970s-style close-up portrait of a Black woman with a large, round afro filling the frame. Low-key lighting, warm skin tones, deep shadows. Add a pale yellow circle in the upper right corner with a slight paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a heavy, rounded display title in white with a red outline at the top center. Inside the yellow circle, add 4-5 lines of bold, condensed black sans-serif text centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the afro the primary texture of the background?
Is the yellow sticker high-contrast against the hair?
Is the title centered at the very top edge?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Record label logos in the corners
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic vinyl sleeve wear and tear.
Ensure the sticker looks like a physical overlay, not a flat digital shape.
Verify the lighting on the face matches the low-key environment.
Confirm the title font has a vintage, hand-drawn quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered, low-key portrait + frame with massive texture (hair/fabric) + add a top-centered heavy display title + balance with an asymmetrical high-contrast geometric sticker.
